payload.title: Text alternatives

sections.heading: Place chart in reading order
sections.text: Column one: tens. Column two: ones. Column three: tenths. Column four: hundredths. Read each digit with its column label. A blank place represents zero units of that size.

sections.heading: Practical alternative
sections.text: Instead of drawing shaded strips, make two text rows. Row one: four tenths equals forty hundredths. Row two: thirty-five hundredths. Compare their quantities verbally, then write your reason. The response can be typed, dictated or handwritten.
